why: DATEX II endpoint pair (LinearByCoordinates -> MultiPoint of 2) for an NRW A2 roadworks, carriageway Oberhausen -> Dortmund (eastbound). Mobilithek NRW needs a certificate that is not available here, so the record was rebuilt as a DATEX II SituationPublication whose LinearByCoordinates start/end are the real endpoints of Autobahn GmbH des Bundes public API (https://verkehr.autobahn.de/o/autobahn), fetched 2026-09-06 roadworks id 2026-042188--vi-fbm.2026-09-09_05-00-00-000.de0 (A2 | Oberhausen - Schwarze Heide) and parsed with parseDatexSituations; the event.json is that parser's output. spine frozen from Overpass on 2026-09-06 via bind:spine (motorway/trunk/primary + links, directed f/b as segment-build.ts builds them). Ground truth was taken from the FULL Autobahn line for the same record (24 vertices), whose densified samples lie 0.0 m on exactly this chain of highway=motorway ref='A 2' oneway ways between the two endpoints.
